jobs.title: Senior Computer Vision Researcher
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. MSc in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Mathematics, or Physics from a leading research university with 3+ years of hands-on deep learning experience in industry, or BSc from a leading research university with 5+ years (exceptionally strong candidates may apply with less experience and strong hands-on research background) Track record of training computer vision models and shipping them to production for real users/customers Strong Python and PyTorch; comfortable owning and evolving a substantial research codebase (not just notebooks)
